"""Generate the fixed-instance measuring spoon removal trajectory."""
from pathlib import Path
import numpy as np


def attempt(s, p, target=(0.267, -0.092, 0.105), yaw=0.0, table=(0.600, -0.320)):
    """Execute and record one candidate trajectory on an initialized Session."""
    s.reset()
    s.record_start()
    q = p["top_down_quat"](yaw)
    start_obj = np.asarray(p["get_object_pose"]("measuring_cup")[0])
    try:
        # Approach the exposed stem of the spoon handle.
        above = [target[0], target[1], 0.230]
        p["move_ee"](above, q, speed=0.16, max_dq=0.06, settle=3)
        # The unrestrained spoon settles into the bowl during the approach.
        p["hold"](12)
        p["move_ee"](target, q, speed=0.06, max_dq=0.025, settle=4)
        p["close_gripper"](20)
        p["hold"](5)

        # Lift clear of the bowl before translating over the table.
        p["move_ee"]([target[0], target[1], 0.205], q, speed=0.05, max_dq=0.025, settle=5)
        after_lift = np.asarray(p["get_object_pose"]("measuring_cup")[0])
        print("OBJECT AFTER LIFT", after_lift, "delta", np.round(after_lift - start_obj, 4), flush=True)
        print("AFTER LIFT STATUS", s.status(), flush=True)
        if not s.status()["success"]:
            # Lift high enough to clear the rim. If the object stays pinched, carry it to the table.
            p["move_ee"]([target[0], target[1], 0.285], q, speed=0.045, max_dq=0.022, settle=5)
            print("AFTER HIGH LIFT", s.status(), p["get_object_pose"]("measuring_cup"), flush=True)
        if not s.status()["success"]:
            p["move_ee"]([table[0], table[1], 0.205], q, speed=0.12, max_dq=0.045, settle=4)
            p["open_gripper"](20)
            p["hold"](25)
    except Exception as exc:
        print("trajectory attempt exception:", repr(exc), flush=True)
    actions = s.record_stop()
    out = Path("/app/output")
    out.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    s.save_trajectory(actions, out / "trajectory.npz", meta={"strategy": "top_down_handle_pick_and_table_release"})
    print("RECORDED", actions.shape, "STATUS", s.status(), flush=True)
    return actions
